leaflet-map.js: var map=L.map("map");L.tileLayer("https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",{maxZoom:19,attribution:"Tiles © Esri"}).addTo(map);var q=(window.iuiSandbox&&window.iuiSandbox.bindings&&window.iuiSandbox.bindings.place)||"city park";document.getElementById("hint").textContent="定位中…";fetch("https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&limit=1&q="+encodeURIComponent(q)).then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(rows){if(!rows[0]){map.setView([20,0],2);document.getElementById("hint").textContent="未能定位，请改 bindings.place";return;}var lat=parseFloat(rows[0].lat),lng=parseFloat(rows[0].lon);map.setView([lat,lng],15);L.marker([lat,lng]).addTo(map).bindPopup(rows[0].display_name||q).openPopup();document.getElementById("hint").textContent=rows[0].display_name||q;}).catch(function(){map.setView([20,0],2);document.getElementById("hint").textContent="定位服务暂不可用";});

sort-viz.js: var arr=[4,7,2,9,1,5,8,3],busy=false,cmp=0,swp=0;function stat(){document.getElementById("cmp").textContent=cmp;document.getElementById("swp").textContent=swp}function paint(active){var el=document.getElementById("bars");el.innerHTML="";var max=Math.max.apply(null,arr);arr.forEach(function(v,i){var d=document.createElement("div");d.className="bar"+(active===i||active===i-1?" active":"");d.style.height=Math.max(24,(v/max)*180)+"px";d.textContent=v;el.appendChild(d)});stat()}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)})}async function bubble(){if(busy)return;busy=true;cmp=0;swp=0;var a=arr.slice();var fast=window.iuiSandbox&&window.iuiSandbox.reducedMotion;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){for(var j=0;j<a.length-i-1;j++){arr=a;cmp++;paint(j+1);if(!fast)await sleep(120);if(a[j]>a[j+1]){var t=a[j];a[j]=a[j+1];a[j+1]=t;swp++}}}arr=a;paint(-9);document.querySelectorAll(".bar").forEach(function(b){b.classList.add("done")});busy=false;window.iuiSandbox.action("sort_done",{arr:arr})}document.getElementById("run").onclick=bubble;document.getElementById("shuffle").onclick=function(){if(busy)return;cmp=0;swp=0;arr=arr.map(function(){return 1+Math.floor(Math.random()*9)});paint(-9)};paint(-9);

meeting-rooms.css: .head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}.room{gap:8px;padding:14px;border-radius:var(--border-radius-lg);background:var(--color-background-primary);border:0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary)}.room .top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.st{flex:none;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:600;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px}.st.free{background:var(--color-background-success);color:var(--color-text-success)}.st.busy{background:var(--color-background-danger);color:var(--color-text-danger)}.st.soon{background:var(--color-background-warning);color:var(--color-text-warning)}.gantt{margin-top:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:var(--border-radius-lg);background:var(--color-background-primary);border:0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary)}.gantt h3{margin:0 0 6px}.gr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(64px,96px) 1fr;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:30px}.gr .nm{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--color-text-secondary);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.tl{position:relative;height:16px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-background-secondary)}.tl i{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:4px;background:var(--accent-fill)}.tl b{position:absolute;top:-4px;bottom:-4px;width:2px;background:var(--color-text-danger);border-radius:1px}.ticks{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--color-text-secondary)}.room button{width:100%}#rooms{margin-top:12px}
